prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. National cultural heritage travel illustration in the visual style of Day of the Tentacle adventure-game backgrounds with strongly exaggerated wonky angular architecture, crooked perspective and thick dark plum ink contours, combined with sculpted cel-shaded 3D volume, soft cast shadows, ambient occlusion and visible layered depth. NOT a realistic photo. Clear foreground/middle/background separation for parallax shader presentation, atmospheric distant scenery, bold silhouettes and rich organized details. Use real recognizable landmarks from the specified country only, regionally accurate natural animals in separate appropriate habitats. No invented landmark combinations presented as a literal place: this is explicitly a national travel montage. Natural animals without clothes, anthropomorphism or silly expressions. No octopuses, tentacles, fantasy creatures, silly characters or people. No words, lettering, flags, logos, watermarks or national emblems. STRICT EVERYWHERE even tiny skyline: no mosque, minaret, Islamic religious architecture, Islamic symbols, religious crescents, Islamic inscriptions or calligraphy. Civilian background houses only. Authentic Christian churches/cathedrals, Buddhist/Hindu temples, synagogues and ancient sacred monuments ARE allowed and encouraged when significant; do not exclude permitted landmarks merely because religious. Represent listed authentic regional sites without inventing extra religious buildings. Final composition is a broad representative regional selection, never all districts or exhaustive heritage. Keep every primary landmark roof and all animal silhouettes fully inside frame, with margins. Country: Trinidad & Tobago. Palette from supplied collection: #81A9F0 #9ED3F4 #AEDED2 #C0C4EC, supported by muted natural stone, wood and vegetation colors with purple shadows. Focus ONLY on Queen's Royal College with one natural scarlet ibis, a few chaconia accents and an atmospheric hint of the country landscape. Large iconic readable shapes, generous central circular crop safe margin. Square1:1 final512x512.

MANDATORY CAMERA FRAMING OVERRIDE: Pull camera back. All animals must be modest sized, completely visible from nose through tail and ALL feet or flippers or wings, with at least 10 percent of canvas width clear to nearest edge. Use the center-right area x=0.60 to 0.75 rather than extreme right. Flying birds or bats MUST fit wholly inside x=0.60 to 0.82 and y=0.12 to 0.30. No animal may touch any canvas border. Keep entire principal landmark and every roof within generous margin. In square avatars, center the full principal landmark inside the central 70 percent of image and keep foreground animal inside central 75 percent. Framing issue to prevent: Cathedral roof and right side cropped; keep full principal landmark with circular crop safe margin.
No extra baby animals at borders. Keep same country, style, color palette, subjects and regional montage concept.

FINAL COMPOSITION PRIORITY: Queen's Royal College, a secular historic college in Port of Spain, is the only principal building. Show its ENTIRE symmetric main block, BOTH side wings, ALL roofs and central clock tower from far enough away, wholly contained within x=0.20 to 0.80 and y=0.22 to 0.66. It must occupy at most 60 percent of canvas width. Leave open garden lawn and vegetation between building and each image border. No building is allowed to extend off left or right edges. A single small natural scarlet ibis on the lawn at x=0.65 y=0.76; no other birds or animals. Square illustration. Preserve country palette and thick plum contours with sculpted cel-shaded volume.
